title: Roamhaven Rewards Earn Rate Card
content:
Roamhaven Rewards credits a completed stay with a percentage of its eligible spend. The percentage and the most a single stay can earn depend on the member's tier.

| Tier | Earn rate (percent of eligible spend) | Most credits earned on one stay, bonus included |
|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 2.00 | 250.00 |
| Rewards Silver | 2.25 | 300.00 |
| Rewards Gold | 2.50 | 400.00 |
| Rewards Platinum | 3.00 | 500.00 |
| Rewards Diamond | 3.50 | 750.00 |
| Rewards Ambassador | 4.00 | 1000.00 |

## Eligible spend (all tiers)

Eligible spend is the nightly subtotal and the cleaning fee of the completed stay, taken together and net of refunds. The guest service fee and the occupancy tax are excluded.

*Hypothetical stay:* nightly subtotal 1200.00 USD, cleaning fee 150.00 USD, guest service fee 170.00 USD, occupancy tax 135.00 USD, nothing refunded. Eligible spend is 1350.00 USD: the nightly subtotal and the cleaning fee together; the service fee and the tax are left out. Had 200.00 USD of the nightly subtotal been refunded, eligible spend would be 1150.00 USD.

## Which stays earn (all tiers)

| How the stay ended or was booked | Earns credits? |
|---|---|
| Booked at a non-refundable rate and completed | Yes |
| Cancelled by the guest | No |
| Cancelled by the host | No |

## Posting (all tiers)

Earned credits post 1 calendar day after check-out. A hypothetical stay checked out on 14 June has its credits posted on 15 June; a check-out on 31 August posts on 1 September.
